message: 未知との遭遇

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Do you think this is enough consumables?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Talking to a plushie in the middle of town is kinda weird, you know.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's wrong, Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「Calling me Demon Lord in the middle of town is way weirder, isn't it?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Come on, what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a girl walking without looking.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Huh?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Ouch!」
She crashed right into me while I was leaning against a streetlight taking a break.
If I hadn't been there, she probably would have hit her head on the streetlight.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you alright?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「I-I'm sorry...」

name: Synn
message: 「You have to watch where you're going, or it's dangerous.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Y-Yes. I'm sorry.」
The impact was as light as a gentle breeze.
The girl furrowed her brow uncomfortably, wandering around unsteadily.
She really looked just like a lost little kitten.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you looking for something?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Eek?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're from out of town, aren't you?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「H-H-How could you possibly tell?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you've been looking around restlessly for a while now...」

name: Young Girl
message: 「I-Is that so? *Sigh*... I must be more careful...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is being careful going to solve anything?」

name: Young Girl
message: 「Ugh... Please don't say things that make me anxious...」
I didn't mean to make her anxious, though.

name: Synn
message: 「If you're looking for something, I'd be happy to help.」

name: Young Girl
message: 「N-No! I-I-I'm f-fine!」
Saying that, the girl runs away with unsteady steps.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, she left.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You should've just left someone like that alone.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't want her thinking this is a town where nobody calls out to people in trouble, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's the town I was born and raised in, after all. I'd like her to come to love it, if possible.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's with you? Did you fall for her or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「What would you do if I said, 'I fell for her!'?」

name: Paqy
message: 「There's no way a shy Demon Lord like you could ever say a line like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then don't ask!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「She definitely thought you were just meddling.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... I guess I really did come on a bit too strong.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even setting aside your shady excuse, it's rare to see the Demon Lord get that invested.」

name: Synn
message: 「That girl... her vibe reminds me of someone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, that person.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that person--wait, who?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ask your own heart.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't actually know, do you.」
Well, I don't know either, though.

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, let's head back.」
